key: Hello! I am the Name Rater, the fortune-teller of names!
en: Hello! I am the Name Rater, the fortune-teller of names!
ja: こんにちは! わたしはなまえ判定人、名前の運勢を占う者です!

key: ...Or, I was, until recently.
en: ...Or, I was, until recently.
ja: ……いえ、最近まではそうでした。

key: These days, technology has come so far...
en: These days, technology has come so far...
ja: 最近は、技術がずいぶん進んでしまって……

key: You can just rename your Pokémon straight from the party menu!
en: You can just rename your Pokémon straight from the party menu!
ja: パーティメニューから直接、ポケモンの名前を変えられちゃうんですから!

key: Kids these days, am I right?
en: Kids these days, am I right?
ja: 今どきの子は、まったく。

key: Of course, I COULD still rate your nicknames, if you really wanted me to...
en: Of course, I COULD still rate your nicknames, if you really wanted me to...
ja: もちろん、本当にご希望でしたら、ニックネームの判定はまだできますが……

key: Just for old times' sake...
en: Just for old times' sake...
ja: 昔のよしみでね……

key: What do you say?
en: What do you say?
ja: いかがですか?

key: Which Pokémon's name should I critique?
en: Which Pokémon's name should I critique?
ja: どのポケモンの名前を判定しましょうか?

key: I see. Do come visit again.
en: I see. Do come visit again.
ja: そうですか。また来てくださいね。

key: Now, now... That is merely an Egg!
en: Now, now... That is merely an Egg!
ja: おやおや……それはただのタマゴですよ!

key: Hmmm... \v[3], is it? That is quite a fine name you bestowed.
en: Hmmm... \v[3], is it?  That is quite a fine name you bestowed.
ja: ふむ……\v[3]ですか。なかなか良い名前をつけましたね。

key: But! What say you, if I were to give it a better name?
en: But! What say you, if I were to give it a better name?
ja: ですが! もっと良い名前をつけるとしたら、どうでしょう?

key: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
en: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
ja: ああ、良かった。それでは、新しいニックネームは何にしましょう?

key: Done! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
en: Done! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
ja: 完了です! これよりこのポケモンは、\v[3]と呼ばれます!

key: It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
en: It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
ja: 見た目は前と変わらないのに、これは断然、良くなっていますよ!

key: How fortunate for you!
en: How fortunate for you!
ja: あなたはとても幸運ですね!

key: Done! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[5]!
en: Done! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[5]!
ja: 完了です! これよりこのポケモンは、\v[5]と呼ばれます!

key: It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!
en: It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!
ja: 前よりずっと良い名前です! あなたはとても幸運ですね!

key: Yeah, an old man like me is hardly relevant anymore, huh...
en: Yeah, an old man like me is hardly relevant anymore, huh...
ja: ええ、わたしのような老いぼれは、もうほとんど必要とされていないんですよ……

key: The passage of time is always rough, isn't it?
en: The passage of time is always rough, isn't it?
ja: 時の流れというのは、いつも厳しいものですね。

key: Hello!
en: Hello!
ja: こんにちは!

key: My husband, the Name Rater, is a little unusual among those in his profession.
en: My husband, the Name Rater, is a little unusual among those in his profession.
ja: 夫のなまえ判定人は、同業者の中でも、少し変わっているんです。

key: Unlike the Name Raters in other regions, he doesn't care if the Pokémon you'd like to rate was traded to you.
en: Unlike the Name Raters in other regions, he doesn't care if the Pokémon you'd like to rate was traded to you.
ja: 他の地方のなまえ判定人と違って、判定してほしいポケモンが交換で得たものかどうかは、気にしないんです。

key: He'll give it a new name if you'd like anyway!
en: He'll give it a new name if you'd like anyway!
ja: ご希望なら、とにかく新しい名前をつけてくれますよ!

key: Okay
en: Okay
ja: はい

key: No thanks
en: No thanks
ja: いいえ、結構です

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
